Read the full roundup: #Tech #Dev #AI” @jameshamiltonwriter.com writes, “I’m halfway through and ’s new book and it feels like the most important thing I have read in a very long time. The second part crystallises and clarifies what’s going on with AI / the tech industry in a way that’s terrifying, but vital to understand.” @paulbivand.bsky.social writes, “You may want to read Tom Loosemore's response. Tom was one of the key people in the early Government Digital Service. Government, and others, have been rationing service by complex gateways, which AI leaps. Either raise the gateways or do something else.”

Other views in this conversation are AI Not Wanted. They are arguing a different claim from AI Advancements.

Technology.name: LLMs Fall Short

perspectives.title: LLMs Fall Short

representative_posts.author: nuclearpidgeon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I find that the strengths and weaknesses of LLMs start to make way more sense when you think about them this way

representative_posts.author: dropthet.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm telling you it's a very underrated aspect of why people are so against LLMs; it's the same reason they're so protective of their little fiefdom of whatever little process they have come to own at work. People like spending 3/4 of their time wrangling spreadsheets & other (now archaic) tasks

representative_posts.author: puppy.bzky.team
representative_posts.text: Yeah, I guess I'm a little extra harsh on LLMs precisely because figuring out and understanding code is the part of programming I like the most.

representative_posts.author: postingtreyf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I literally work with automation researchers. LLMs are not people. Nor are they alive. They’re designed to be mimics.

representative_posts.author: thoth.ptnote.dev
representative_posts.text: Maybe you think all use of LLMs is unethical, which I don't agree with but I do see the argument for, but that isn't the same argument as saying they cannot help with learning.

representative_posts.author: vswarte.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm aware you were active and wrote this particular thing before LLMs were a thing. It's just super weird you're suddenly super active now that you've got a clanker to wipe your ass. I'll smell bullshit around anything out of you from here on out after openly promoting your usage of LLMs.

representative_posts.author: ericprindle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: When LLMs started getting integrated into Teams/Slack/Zoom, I was flabbergasted that so many people were willing to yield the power of being the one to decide what, exactly, was decided in the meeting to a stupid robot.

representative_posts.author: adamlasnik.net
representative_posts.text: I would love for people to see this as a continuum, though, or at least not binary LLM-as-tool, LLM-as-girlfriend. Treating LLMs as purely a tool akin to a calculator? Okay. Enjoying your LLM having a bit of "personality" / humor / playfulness in your routine work with it? Also fine. [...]

representative_posts.author: wyrdandnerdy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I can't tell you how much I h8 Sam Altman, Dario Amodei and all the TESCREAList idiots that helped bring us to this moment. The underlying LLMs themselves are not so terrible necessarily. But turning them into chat bots was a terrible idea. And this is just another example as to why.

representative_posts.author: erisianrite.com
representative_posts.text: All the bad parts of LLMs and large models generally (just a bit-player there though) Needing to have ml expertise to wield them for non-ml research Code architecture viz Engineering on research teams My mini painting skills

representative_posts.author: diegzumillo.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The technology isn't there yet. The most sophisticated LLMs have too many safety rails to properly role play. So it's left for some adventurous soul to train their own LLM specifically for role playing, with no safety at all... no one has been brave enough yet.

representative_posts.author: wnz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: One of the things I really like about llms and coding is that now I can quickly build local first tools for myself, while in the past I would have signed up to some "free" micro saas and most likely shared my data.

representative_posts.author: iankiambi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: LLMs are literally not conscious. This is basic AI literacy 101.

representative_posts.author: e-infinity.space
representative_posts.text: What’s the panpsychic view of LLM consciousness? The Discover feed is too cowardly to show me.

representative_posts.author: dbeecher.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm certainly not going to be persuaded of consciousness without independence. If I sit here in my chair without direction my mind is still doing things. An LLM can't act without an external consciousness asking it to do something.

representative_posts.author: onefeincat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The whole "are LLMs conscious" back-and-forth makes me feel like more people need to read Blindsight.

Culture.name: UK Porn Ban

perspectives.title: UK Porn Ban
perspectives.summary: UK bans certain types of porn

representative_posts.author: bussybuckboi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So the UK is banning several porn types that I don’t care for (like incest and abdl porn) However I do know that roleplaying doesn’t hurt anybody and even if I’m not into it at all this sets a slippery slope precedent for banning any porn at all for no reason other than “it makes me uncomfy”

representative_posts.author: chorizo-chomper.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Just reading the porn ban incoming and it's phenomenally bad law Most porn produced in the last ten years has some elements of what they're banning

representative_posts.author: lamuradex.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: WHY DO THIS?! With so many terrible things happening in the world, so many tragedies and terrors, who is seriously so bothered by a genre of porn that they'd pass laws to stop it. Someone in government need to get some FUCKING perspective.

representative_posts.author: capnshores.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Thats non-consent. And thus, assault. The idea that porn is somehow ‘corrupting’ people into doing awful things, rather than it being a healthy outlet or even a vibrant subculture and economic factor of society, is absurd.

representative_posts.author: ukpolitics.papernaut.co
representative_posts.text: THE INDEPENDENT: From 6 November, UK law will ban porn depicting strangulation, incest and adults pretending to be under 16, following cross-party pressure over its impact on women and girls. - by Harry Taylor

representative_posts.author: adamt1966.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I didn't even know there were new porn bans in the UK. What's no longer allowed that was previously allowed? If it's glorifying violence, I can see the justification. Even if the participants consent, you never know what it might trigger in some viewers. Link?

representative_posts.author: razz-says.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: England and Wales banning breath-play porn from what I can read. Quite a few prodommes and fetish content creators are going to have a shock when the activists turn up...

representative_posts.author: chorizo-chomper.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Millions of people in the UK will watch porn regularly but those videos don't say beforehand whether they include these new banned acts. You're effectively criminalising millions of people to the same level as paedophiles for watching videos with consenting adults having sex.

representative_posts.author: squidfromspace.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Someone sat down and thought "How can we ban porn where a female performer calls her male co-star daddy, without making criminals of either Games of Thrones fans, or people who still have pictures of the Dahm triplets on their hard-drives?".

representative_posts.author: inflatabledalek.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: LRP, ZI don't think anyone wants to mentally connect me with porn so I'm not going to bang on about this, but even beyond the ridiculousness of banning adults dressing up, that is absolutely going to be what lets a future Farage government ban a whole lot more.

representative_posts.author: lordmimey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The porn ban isn't about morality, but about justifying a police state. Everything else from that is simply smoke and mirrors. Yes it'll be used to kill Undesirables, but more than that, it'll help set up a permanent policing of the entire internet for any 'wrongthink' going forward, porn be damned.

representative_posts.author: lordmimey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I know this is cliche but this is really 1984 type shit. in that porn was, by the law, banned, but The Party not only allowed it, but created and distributed it to people, seeing it as another form of control, then only tagging someone for the porn if they started stepping out of line too much.

representative_posts.author: selenophilensfw.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anyone know if that upcoming UK porn ban covers illustrations or just irl porn? I find the lack of details as alarming as the INSANE overreach. like holy shit this is a slippery slope... Idc if these are your kinks or not, banning certain kinks protects no one and harms EVERYONE.

representative_posts.author: megasoups.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Addendum to the UK porn ban thing: It's not going to stay there. They'll start trying this porn ban shit at *any* moment in any other country. Solidarity, people. Now, please. #savespeech #privacy #censorship #furry

representative_posts.author: stevenpreston.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Does the UK porn ban mean someone has to watch all the porn to make sure it doesn't contain the things that are banned?

representative_posts.author: erikahall.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Apart from CSAM and non-consensual porn, and probably something else evil I'm forgetting, I take a pretty hard line on not criminalizing porn because it's a wide net that catches all sorts of expression and doesn't achieve its purported goals.

representative_posts.author: secretman11.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So is your goal to ban men's and women's health magazines and tiktok? Because the very article you're citing admits it's not "porn" that's the exclusive motivating factor in media at all. You'd have to censor every publication in existence from discussing sex at all without government approval.

representative_posts.author: transmagicgirl.moe.observer
representative_posts.text: I'm noticing that a lot of outlets keep leaving out the part about ageplay being banned in porn in the UK as well

representative_posts.author: magscampbell.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I did not like that BBC headline the other day about choking and incest being banned in porn. Conflating kink and incest, making them sound equally disgusting, is so wrong. There's been a lot of puritanical criticism of consensual BDSM online and in the media by people insisting it's always abusive.

representative_posts.author: mintincubus.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: but that argument cannot be applied to fictional underage content bc of how pedophilic the porn industry (and media at large + beauty standards in the US) already is. if u create or consume underage content u are feeding a larger machine that serves tangible harm to EVERYONE...

representative_posts.author: nicoletenshi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is what gets me, there are like ACTUAL problems with how a lot of what is presented front and center as the Most Normal Standard Material if you go looking for porn is stuff that features dangerous violence without any form of disclaimer but that's not a porn problem it's an info problem

representative_posts.author: erikahall.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The problem is porn fills the gap left by a lack of sex education, which should include relationships, consent, communication, power dynamics, cultural scripts, and how to recognize and exit unsafe situations. I am angrier at a lot of romcoms than I am at porn.

representative_posts.author: nicoletenshi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: You don't solve that by making sure no one could ever possibly see that kind of porn, you solve it by giving people, ESPECIALLY young people, information that corrects the passive misinfo they get from the culture

representative_posts.author: gizmotron.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yep. 100% agree. As for choking - people can do it if they want. They can bum Lego or slap their tits against broken glass. I do not care. But given that a) our technological restriction of porn is non-existent and b) kids still access it, I'm happy for the extreme variants (or all) to be barred.

representative_posts.author: gizmotron.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Porn is ubiquitous on the Internet in a way that movies are not. Movie IP is way more tightly controlled. Children don't have free and frank access to R-rated movies in the way that they can access any kind of pornography they like. Google images, banner ads, open porn sites. It's everywhere.

representative_posts.author: pennicat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think you’re allowed to have choking someone as part of an abusive relationship in a story for over 18s if it’s clearly done in a “make people miserable” way and not as part of pornographic writing, as that isn’t porn. But maybe I’m wrong.

representative_posts.author: serakhtis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: also, banning shit because pedos like it??? like i assume thats the reasoning for the abdl or adults pretending to be minors, is just blatantly stupid, even within their own mythology cause like, 1 pedos should be allowed some kind of porn "as a distraction" or whatever, it seems ->

representative_posts.author: sillydollthing.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It criminalises step daughter porn lmao, I think I remember one of the studies into it saying that was like 5% of pornography on mainstream porn sites

representative_posts.author: sillydollthing.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's still so funny that the governments pr line on one hand for strangulation porn and whatnot is "oh it's just about the online landscape" while it's legal line is "delete all of it from your phone or you will go to rapists jail"

representative_posts.author: jaqrabbittales.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm not saying that sex between family members is healthy. I'm pretty sure it usually isn't. But... it's a pretty common fantasy. And that's what porn – even including mine – is. Fantasy. What I write and draw might've happened. Or not. And its legal status shouldn't depend on that.

representative_posts.author: chaudfraud.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: and yes, i actually do want you to explain why. it's certainly not how it would affect the child when they saw it, because they are a child (let's say 5 years old) and you are insane if you are showing them the porn made of them even as a rhetorical device.

representative_posts.author: gothchik17.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Straight people shouldn't be allowed to write, draw, or enjoy porn of any kind.

representative_posts.author: nparticipacion.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: does make me think about the categories sidebar on porn sites, it often feels designed by a particularly debauched and misanthropic colonial governor from the 19th century

representative_posts.author: inflatabledalek.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Considering most porn (presumably because of existing laws) will usually put its disclaimers into dialogue ("It's not like I'm your real sister"/"I am 18") I wonder how long before someone challenges this with "Your honour, that was not her mother."

representative_posts.author: lucytabs.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: a country banning incest porn whose kings and queens have been famously inbred is wild.

representative_posts.author: tgweaver.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: K.E. 17 "Censorplay" This one ties in heavily with meta porn, character awareness, etc. There are many ways to play with the concept of a censor bar to make something *more* erotic. Cover up that which leaves little to the imagination. Cover just barely. Cover the wrong thing!

Culture.name: Writing Freedom

perspectives.title: Writing Freedom
perspectives.summary: Writing is more enjoyable without pressure

representative_posts.author: highway62.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I realize this is unhelpful for most people in the field, but I became a lot happier with writing when I understood that I could not make my living from it. Even it supplemented with other writing-adjacent tasks. It's not what folks want to hear. I sure didn't.

representative_posts.author: frostedcarimew.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I started writing again after years of not, cause of the fallout from my old writing group being shit bags over my transition. It’s only just short prose, but I’m still happy I did it. I’m so fucking rusty but it’s nice to have that creative spark again.

representative_posts.author: morvix.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Isn't it nice when your writing can inspire?

representative_posts.author: steveb.wsocial.eu
representative_posts.text: It's always the writer you least expect. Obviously, I'm not allowed to like my own work. Or writing.

representative_posts.author: jhfarr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This makes me want to get a typewriter again for writing. It's not only the physical experience—words go BAM BAM—but being undistracted.

representative_posts.author: cliterallytheebest.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I AGREE!!! It sucks… the fear of making mistakes and the need for perfection needs to end… just accept the feedback you get from your writing so you know what you need to work on moving forward.

representative_posts.author: rootbeercutie.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm trying to fall back in love with writing and I'm trying to treat it like drawn art. Just write the silly, floofy shit! I'm gonna fucking do it!

representative_posts.author: erikvorhes.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I was coming in to say something similar. I haven’t seen anyone seriously claim that writing is the only mode of thinking.

representative_posts.author: wwxwashere.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: people overthink what “improve your writing” means. reading and writing consistently is better than sitting around waiting for the perfect writing to come by. you REALLY need to get comfortable and make a welcoming space for bad writing if you want good fics.

representative_posts.author: theaiprism.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Our own site went through this — the honest answer is that good writing needs fewer, better images, not more of them.

representative_posts.author: ottersediting.com
representative_posts.text: Some people are pantsers and that's okay 🫂 I'm def more of a plotter so a lot of things get done before I start writing to help. I sort of discovered this the hard way too. The first book I ever wrote will never see the light of day because I pantsed it and it was a mess/too difficult to revise.

representative_posts.author: goosepimple.moe
representative_posts.text: believe me i am guilty of that too. lotta redundancies in my writing

representative_posts.author: jgduke.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's been busy and a bit stressful the last few days, friends. I will try to catch up today, assuming work isn't crazy. I'm proud of you all! Your art is brilliant! Keep writing. #WritingCommunity #WritingPromptGames #IndieAuthor

representative_posts.author: systemsymphonyx.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I am writing a bunch of different stories! DMP, about Ai, who's boss literally haunts her. TWH, about a weird town in a void and the weirder denizens, and Hexflame, a dad who protects his daughter from her evil mother whom she's supposed to defeat!! I can't WAIT to share them all with you!!

representative_posts.author: olareader.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Writing a first novel really does come with things you never see coming until you're in the middle of it. I like that you're sharing the journey as it happens. How's the novel coming along? Are you still working through the draft?

representative_posts.author: coripalladium.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Good 😎👍 I have the night off work so I'm going to spend it writing, or drawing beautiful women, one of the two.

representative_posts.author: kmeyergriffith.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “No One Can See Tomorrow immediately caught my attention. Candid reflections on a writing career spanning over five decades,the triumphs,sacrifices,and perseverance,make this memoir deeply human and inspiring”

treating writing like art helps to fall in love with it again
fear of mistakes and perfection hinders writing freedom
writing without expectation of perfection is liberating

Writing Freedom argues that writing is more enjoyable without pressure. writing brings happiness when not done for a living. treating writing like art helps to fall in love with it again. fear of mistakes and perfection hinders writing freedom. writing without expectation of perfection is liberating.

The posts defend it in their own words. @wwxwashere.bsky.social writes, “people overthink what “improve your writing” means. reading and writing consistently is better than sitting around waiting for the perfect writing to come by. you REALLY need to get comfortable and make a welcoming space for bad writing if you want good fics.” @frostedcarimew.bsky.social writes, “I started writing again after years of not, cause of the fallout from my old writing group being shit bags over my transition. It’s only just short prose, but I’m still happy I did it. I’m so fucking rusty but it’s nice to have that creative spark again.” @cliterallytheebest.bsky.social writes, “I AGREE!!! It sucks… the fear of making mistakes and the need for perfection needs to end… just accept the feedback you get from your writing so you know what you need to work on moving forward.”

Inside Writing Freedom, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.

representative_posts.author: imthinkin.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Attention all graduates from law schools! What’s good enough for this regime is damn good enough for you. According to Katie, grad’s can be practicing lawyer’s but can not call themselves an attorney (who definitely must pass the bar)..So why bother to pass the bar?

representative_posts.author: inanedragon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you get your JD, you don't get to say you're a lawyer. If you fail the bar exam, you may or may not get to say you're a lawer.
